svg.title: Star Fort: a map for 5 kings and their peasants
svg.desc: One star fort holds all five kings, each on a raised bastion behind earth ramparts round the central spire: a ramp climbs in at the bastion's point, facing its peasants, and bots-only zigzags climb both its flanks. The peasants hold the five realms outside, parted by ridges with a bots-only pass over each.
svg.text: 5 kings, 3 peasants each · 28 × 28 map (14336 game units square) · 5 teams of 4, 20 players
One star fort holds all five kings, each on a raised bastion behind earth ramparts round the central
spire: a ramp climbs in at the bastion's point, facing its peasants, and bots-only zigzags climb both its
flanks. The peasants hold the five realms outside, parted by ridges with a bots-only pass over each.
Heights: realms 200 · bastions 300, ramparts 90 higher · ridges 380 · the spire 520
Ground: rippled golden dunes in the realms, wind-polished sandstone ridges, pale stone flags inside
Plants: ad0_senegal palms in an oasis ring outside each bastion's door; nothing on the dunes.
Features: rocks30_desert along the ridges and passes, armsolar_dead and armadvsol_dead half-buried
Sky and weather: deep blue sky, sand haze on the horizon; wind 12 to 28; tidal 0.
Each fifth is the same, turned 72° about the centre. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
